text: Councillor Gary Crawford recommends that the Budget Committee establish four Subcommittees in order to meet concurrently in two locations, on each of the two days of public presentations scheduled for January 17 and 18, 2023. These Subcommittees will report to the Budget Committee on their activities as part of the 2023 Budget Process.

The Budget Committee: 1. Established four subcommittees to hear public presentation on the 2023 Budget as follows: Date and Session Times Locations Subcommittee Membership January 17 9:30 am to 12:30 pm 1:30 pm to 4:30 pm; 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm City Hall, Committee Room 1, 100 Queen Street West, 2 nd Floor and by Video Conference Councillor Alejandra Bravo; Councillor Gary Crawford (Chair); and Councillor Chris Moise. January 17 1:30 pm to 4:30 pm 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm North York Civic Centre, Council Chamber, 5100 Yonge Street and by Video Conference Councillor Vincent Crisanti; Councillor Frances Nunziata (Chair); and Councillor Michael Thompson. January 18 1:30 pm to 4:30 pm 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm Scarborough Civic Centre, Council Chamber, 150 Borough Drive and by Video Conference Councillor Gary Crawford (Chair); Councillor Chris Moise; and Councillor Michael Thompson.
